drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thanks for the draft. We have revised it to address the compensation, severance, and restrictive covenant points your client raised: the package now includes a materially higher base salary and target bonus, a broader severance structure with good-reason resignation rights and continued benefits, and a narrower post-employment restriction in duration, scope, and geographic reach. Please let us know if you would like us to mark up any additional open items.

edits.text: 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer and shall perform such duties consistent with that position as are reasonably assigned by the Company.
edits.name: position

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $375,000, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, and shall be eligible to earn an annual target bonus equal to 50% of base salary, subject to the achievement of mutually agreed performance objectives and the Company’s ordinary bonus administration practices. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in the Company’s benefit plans generally available to senior executives, as such plans may be amended from time to time.
edits.name: compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Executive’s employment is terminated by the Company without Cause or by the Executive for Good Reason, the Executive shall be entitled to: (a) severance pay equal to twelve (12) months of base salary plus the Executive’s target annual bonus, payable in accordance with the Company’s standard payroll practices over the severance period; (b) payment of any earned but unpaid bonus for the prior completed fiscal year, if any; and (c) continued participation in, or reimbursement for the cost of, medical, dental, and vision benefits for twelve (12) months following termination, or such shorter period as required by law or the governing plan terms. Good Reason shall include a material diminution in title, authority, duties, or reporting relationship; a material reduction in base salary or target bonus opportunity; a required relocation of the Executive’s principal work location by more than 30 miles; or any material breach of this Agreement by the Company, in each case after notice and a reasonable cure period.
edits.name: severance

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. During the six (6) months following termination of employment, the Executive shall not, within the geographic area in which the Executive materially performed services for the Company during the final twelve (12) months of employment, engage in a business that is directly and specifically competitive with the business lines in which the Executive had material responsibility during the final twelve (12) months of employment. This restriction shall not prohibit passive ownership of less than 5% of a publicly traded company, nor shall it restrict the Executive from engaging in activities that do not involve the Company’s confidential information, customers, or employees.
edits.name: noncompete
